10.constraint: Use this washed-pink controlled relaxed zip hoodie once only for Premium Spring/Fall Casual Everyday, Travel, Campus, creative daytime Party or a playful Date look. Make it the single high-impact color with a clean straight or tapered bottom in ecru, stone, light gray, washed blue or soft charcoal and a low-profile cream, gray or white shoe; never use the matching pink bottom, a graphic tee, a baggy or puddled trouser, a bulky trainer, another oversized layer or any Wedding/Wedding Guest outfit.
